parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The time this event happened. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.description: If a MLD, the MAC Address of the AP MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID) which is reporting the Association Event.

parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: If a MLD, the MAC Address of the Client MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: StatusCode
parameters.description: The status code sent to the Associated Device (STA) in the Association Response frame as defined by {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-50}}.

parameters.name: HTCapabilities
parameters.description: Describes the HT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: VHTCapabilities
parameters.description: Describes the VHT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: HECapabilities
parameters.description: Describes the HE capabilities of the Associated Device (STA). {{deprecated|2.16|because it is superseded by {{object|WiFi6Capabilities}}.}} {{obsoleted|2.18}} {{deleted|2.19}}

parameters.name: ClientCapabilities
parameters.description: The frame body of the (Re)Association Request frame received from this client (STA), as defined in Table 9-34 and Table 9-36 of {{bibref|802.11-2020}} in the order of the underlying referenced standard.

parameters.name: OpClass
parameters.description: Operating class in use at the time of this event, from {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}. May be determined from {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV}} and the Supported Operating Classes element in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV}}. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the operating class over which association messaging had occurred.

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: The single channel number of the channel in use at the time of this event. May be determined from {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV}} and the Supported Operating Classes element in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV}}. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the channel over which association messaging had occurred.

object.description: The events generated when an Associated Device (STA) associates to a BSS. {{deprecated|2.17|because a corresponding USP event is defined instead}} {{obsoleted|2.19}}
